capabilities: find semantically similar notes via cosine similarity over embeddings
insert and maintain a managed related-links block in notes
configure result count, similarity threshold, and excluded folders
reload the embeddings index after reindexing
extras: The plugin itself performs no AI inference; it only reads the embeddings data.json file that the Vector Search plugin produces, so both plugins (and Ollama) must be set up first.
intentEvidence: This plugin requires Vector Search plugin to generate embeddings for your notes.
problem: Obsidian's linking is manual and keyword-based, so meaningful connections between notes that don't share words go undiscovered.

relations.evidence: Uses embeddings from Vector Search by @ashwin271

summary: Inserts a managed block of semantically related note links at the end of a note, computed from pre-computed AI embeddings.
